sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Dhananjay
Sharma, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Vishal Panwar, Additional Advocate General, for the respondentState.
Cr. Mp (M) No. 228 of 2025 Heard.
2.  Mr. Vishal Panwar, Learned Additional Advocate General appears and waives service of notice on behalf of respondentState.
He prays for and is granted two weeks' time to file reply/status report.

3. Bail Petitioner [Jitender Kataik] has come up before this Court under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "BNSS") for the grant of prearrest bail in connection with FIR No.161/2022 registered on 21.12.2022, at Police Station Theog, District Sirmour (H.P.), under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
4.

Case as setup by Mr. Dhananjay Sharma, Learned Counsel is that the bail petitioner [Jitender Kataik] is a Government Employee working as Senior Assistant in Settlement Department Shimla Division and is a law abiding citizen having no criminal record, and he have never been involved in any act or omission of criminal nature.
5. It is further averred that one Sandeep Kumar Mehta had committed a fraud in 2018 as mentioned in Annexure P1, but the petitioner has been falsely implicated in aforesaid accusation.

It is averred that the main accused, namely, Sandeep Kumar Mehta, had defrauding dozens of orchardists in various parts of the State including Shimla and Solan Districts and a Police Challan No.32/2022 [Annexure P5] has been presented by the police before Learned Trial Court against Sandeep Kumar Mehta aforesaid and the trial is pending adjudication before the Learned CJM, Court Solan.

6. It is further averred that the present bail petitioner [Jitender Kataik] is one of the complainant and is a witness against Sandeep Kumar Mehta, against whom, a Police Challan No. 32/2022 [Annexure P5] has been filed, which is pending trial.
7. It is further averred that the bail petitioner is not at all involved with misappropriation of money involved in alleged fraud.
It is further averred that the petitioner has not committed any offence whatsoever and has been wrongly dragged in connection with aforesaid FIR.
Learned Counsel for petitioner has submitted that the matter is of civil nature and a Civil Suit No.145/2022 is pending before Hon'ble Court.

8. It is averred that no custodial interrogation of petitioner is required in instant FIR and the petitioner states that he has participated in Investigation about 56 times earlier.
9.
Bail petitioner has furnished undertakings that he shall join the Investigation as and when required or is directed to do so by this Court.

sentences.text:
It is further averred that petitioner is the only bread earner in the family and there is no earning male member in his family.
11.
Taking into account, the entirety of the facts and circumstances and the material on record and the submissions made by Learned Counsel for petitioner

, this Court is of the considered view, that the interim protection needs to be accorded to the petitioner at this stage for the reason, that the bail petitioner is a Government Employee as Senior Assistant working in Settlement Department Shimla Division.
Even the denial of bail can neither be preventive nor punitive.
The object of bail is to ensure participation in Investigation and the Trial thereafter so as to test, examine and prove the accusation in accordance with law.

Material on record further reveals that the FIR No.161/2022 was registered on 21.12.2022 at Police Station Theog, District Shimla and the bail petitioner has participated in the Investigation on 56 occasions earlier as referred to above.

Material on record reveals that the petitioner is also a victim of fraud by Sandeep Kumar Mehta, for which petitioner had lodged an FIR No.155/2018 dated 01.08.2018 at Police Station Theog, District Shimla and after formation of Special SIT, in the year 2019, an FIR No. 36/2020 was registered by CID, Solan which is pending adjudication as Police Challan No.32/2022 [Annexure P5] before the Learned Trial Court at Solan.
12. In these circumstances, the petitioner has carved out a case for grant of on interim protection at this stage.

Involvement in any offence whatsoever or abetting thereof shall entail automatic cancellation of bail granted in terms of this order;
(vi) Petitioner shall disclose his functional E Mail IDs/ WhatsApp number and that of his surety to the Investigating Officer;
